note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a FIN 13, 14, 15, 18, 18(a), 18(b), 19, 19(a), 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 6; A06b FIN 13, 14, 15, 18, 18(a), 18(b), 19, 19(a), 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 6; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Act 474/2024 (5 July 2024, in force 1 October 2024) raised the residence requirement: the Nationality Act's section 13 as Finlex consolidates it asks that the applicant's actual residence and home be, and have been, in Finland for the last eight years; nothing on renunciation or loss changed.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Finland, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Finland for 5 years uninterrupted, or 7 years since the age of 15 with the last 2 years uninterrupted. (In both cases the residence requirement can be shortened with 1 year if applicant meets language requirements.) Section 18: Exceptions to the period of residence. Section 18a: Exceptions to the period of residence when the language requirement is fulfiled. ... n.a. ... n.a.

sources.said: Ulkomaalaiselle myönnetään hakemuksesta Suomen kansalaisuus, jos hakemusta ratkaistaessa: 1) hän on täyttänyt 18 vuotta; (24.10.2025/929) 2) hänen varsinainen asuntonsa ja kotinsa on ja on ollut Suomessa viimeksi kuluneet kahdeksan vuotta ( asumisaikaedellytys ); (5.7.2024/474)
